faqs.question: Can you guarantee coverage?
faqs.answer: No one can honestly guarantee editorial coverage. We maximize your odds with strong, newsworthy writing and targeted distribution to the right outlets.

faqs.question: Do you write in Arabic for regional media?
faqs.answer: Yes — we produce bilingual releases tailored for both Arabic and English outlets across the GCC.

faqs.question: Do you deliver in Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes — bilingual Arabic + English with full RTL support, so both audiences get a first-class experience.

faqs.question: Do we own the result?
faqs.answer: Completely. You keep the accounts, data, configurations, and documentation. There is no lock-in to CloudTopia.
